title: Export Top-only product shipment unit summaries to PDF
description: A user downloads the current product ranking design with unit-separated quantity summary evidence as PDF. Extend the existing PDF endpoint/exporter using the same freshly authorized preview and existing PDFsharp/SimHeiPdfFontResolver. When unit grouping is selected render stable group sections with bucket counts, signed known-unit subtotals and explicit unknown quantities, with row/page pagination and current Top/filter/date/unit context. Retain selected detail column order and none-group PDF compatibility. Never include money, cross-unit grand quantity or full-range completeness claims; missing font/render failures return a clear error with no corrupt file. Designer sends all current request values and reports failure; Excel remains compatible. Development only: reuse approved nondeleted StockOut/StockOutDetails evidence, the product-sales-ranking menu and fresh current-user SalespersonDataScopeService; retain existing OperationLogMiddleware HTTP audit. Never widen ERP permissions or accept client rows/aggregates as authority. No arbitrary/model-generated SQL, direct business/table writes, new domain entities or persistence schema, schema/view/stored-procedure changes, migrations, production SQL or real database execution, production deployment, secrets/.env/config changes, irreversible operations or real browser acceptance. Keep unrelated work. Run focused in-memory unit/API/export/UI source-contract tests plus configured safe Release build/test. Any external environment acceptance that cannot run must be marked environment-blocked, never fabricated passed.
acceptance_criteria: PDF reruns current authorization/validation and consumes server-derived filtered Top groups, rejecting revoked/invalid requests without a file and retaining none-group compatibility.

Infrastructure PDF exporter renders exact-unit Top-only counts and signed known quantities with unknown-unit evidence, pagination and normalized filter context, preserving detail columns and explicit font/render failure.
Designer preserves current grouping/filter/date/Top/fields in PDF requests and error states; focused PDF/UI and Excel compatibility tests plus safe Release build/test pass.
